claims.quote: the vesicular SNARE VAMP-2, a direct α-Syn interactor,

the striatal levels of the vesicular SNARE VAMP-2, a direct α-Syn interactor, and of the transmembrane SNARE synaptosome-associated protein 23 (SNAP-23), that promotes glutamate synaptic vesicles release, were markedly decreased in mutant mice.
